message: `main` reaches operation `ask` of effect `Ask` with no handler: the process would write `axiom: unhandled effect` and exit 71 there - in `main`'s own body
label: reaches `Ask` with nothing handling it
help: install one - `(handle BODY (E) HANDLER)` around the call - or, if an unhandled operation of this effect is a deliberate abort as `Assert`'s is, write `;@axiom:unhandled(trap)` above its `effect` declaration

message: effect operation `ask` cannot be used as a bare value; call it, or wrap it: `(lambda (x) (ask x))`
